summary: For vascular plants the WCVP bulk download holds every variable except an effort covariate: genus, species, taxon_rank, infraspecific_rank and accepted-name links per name, plus country-level (TDWG level 3) distributions. Beetle faunas in Darwin's original scope have no equivalent dataset found; GBIF occurrence counts can supply an effort covariate. Status is partial only because the animal half and the effort control were not located in one table.
next_step: Download wcvp.zip (84 MB, outside the scout budget), derive genus size per country from wcvp_distribution.csv joined to wcvp_names.csv, count variety-rank names per accepted species, and pre-register the effort covariate (e.g. GBIF occurrences per species).
obstacles_confirmed: Variety rank is used unevenly across clades and is often absent from global checklists; WCVP records infraspecific_rank but its consistency was not measured.
POWO API is blocked by Cloudflare (403); the bulk zip is the open route.
No open beetle checklist with variety counts was found within the request budget.
